name: Chorionic gonadotropin
description: A placental glycoprotein hormone that agonises the LH receptor, approved for prepubertal cryptorchidism, hypogonadotropic hypogonadism in males and ovulation induction in females. Carries a boxed warning against use for weight loss.

systems.note: LH receptor agonism driving testicular steroidogenesis; the labelled indication.
Raised endogenous testosterone carries the same erythrocytosis concern as exogenous androgen.
Raised endogenous androgen reaches prostatic tissue.

monitors.why: The effect the drug is given for.
Intratesticular aromatisation rises markedly under hCG stimulation.
Raised endogenous androgen carries the class erythrocytosis concern.
Raised endogenous androgen reaches prostatic tissue.
